{

  "architecture_contract": {
    "design": {
      "name": "tiled_int8_fc",
      "version": "1.0.0",
      "description": "An 8x8 output-stationary INT8 GEMM accelerator with INT32 accumulation, mandatory bias addition, and mandatory ReLU. Inputs are loaded once per job; results are streamed in tile-major order."
    },
    "operations": [
      {
        "name": "gemm",
        "kind": "matrix_multiply",
        "semantics": "Mandatory. For each 0<=m<M and 0<=n<N, initialize S[m,n]=0 and, for k=0 through K-1 in increasing order, update S[m,n]=wrap32(S[m,n]+signed(A[m,k])*signed(W[k,n])). Each product is an exact signed 16-bit value sign-extended to 32 bits before addition.",
        "inputs": ["A", "W"],
        "outputs": ["S"]
      },
      {
        "name": "add_bias",
        "kind": "broadcast_add",
        "semantics": "Mandatory, after the corresponding GEMM element is complete. Z[m,n]=wrap32(S[m,n]+B[n]); bias is broadcast across rows.",
        "inputs": ["S", "B"],
        "outputs": ["Z"]
      },
      {
        "name": "relu",
        "kind": "activation",
        "semantics": "Mandatory, after bias addition. Y[m,n]=0 if signed Z[m,n]<0; otherwise Y[m,n]=Z[m,n]. No requantization or INT8 output conversion.",
        "inputs": ["Z"],
        "outputs": ["Y"]
      }
    ],
    "data_types": [
      {
        "name": "int8",
        "role": "Activation and weight elements",
        "width_bits": 8,
        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Two's-complement integer, range -128 through 127.",
        "conversion_semantics": "Input data bits [7:0] supply the element; bits [31:8] are ignored. Arithmetic extensions are sign extensions.",
        "overflow_semantics": "No input arithmetic conversion; the low byte is interpreted directly.",
        "rounding_semantics": "None."
      },
      {
        "name": "int16_product",
        "role": "Internal multiplier result",
        "width_bits": 16,
        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Exact two's-complement product of two int8 operands.",
        "conversion_semantics": "Sign-extend all 16 product bits to 32 bits before accumulation.",
        "overflow_semantics": "Every int8-by-int8 product fits exactly.",
        "rounding_semantics": "None."
      },
      {
        "name": "int32",
        "role": "Bias, accumulated sums, biased values, and output elements",
        "width_bits": 32,
        "signed": true,
        "representation": "Two's-complement integer. wrap32 retains the low 32 bits and interprets them as signed.",
        "conversion_semantics": "Bias and output use all 32 interface bits directly.",
        "overflow_semantics": "Every accumulation and bias addition wraps modulo 2^32. ReLU tests the sign of the wrapped bias-add result.",

    "control": {
      "strategy": "Single synchronous FSM with one active job and no command queue. Reset has priority over every transfer and state update. done and error are one-cycle registered event pulses, defaulting low each non-reset edge.",
      "state_progression": "IDLE: accept command; illegal dimensions pulse error and remain IDLE, otherwise enter LOAD_A. LOAD_A -> LOAD_W after M*K transfers; LOAD_W -> LOAD_B after K*N transfers; LOAD_B -> CLEAR_TILE after N transfers. CLEAR_TILE -> GATHER_REQ -> GATHER_CAPTURE, repeating for eight lanes -> MAC. MAC repeats gathering until K iterations complete, then BIAS_REQ -> FINALIZE -> EMIT. An accepted nonfinal tile element advances local column, wrapping to the next local row, and returns to BIAS_REQ. Last accepted tile element advances tn, wrapping to tm, then enters CLEAR_TILE. Last accepted job element clears busy, pulses done, and enters IDLE.",
      "counters": [
        "Latched M/N/K widths are respectively max(1,$clog2(MAX_M+1)), max(1,$clog2(MAX_N+1)), and max(1,$clog2(MAX_K+1)).",
        "A load index width=max(1,$clog2(MAX_M*MAX_K+1)); W load index width=max(1,$clog2(MAX_K*MAX_N+1)); B load index width=max(1,$clog2(MAX_N+1)). Increment only on their load handshakes and compare against runtime count minus one.",
        "Tile-row ordinal tm width=max(1,$clog2((MAX_M+7)/8)); tile-column ordinal tn width=max(1,$clog2((MAX_N+7)/8)). Runtime tile counts are ceil(M/8) and ceil(N/8).",
        "k width=max(1,$clog2(MAX_K+1)), range 0..K-1; lane is 3 bits, range 0..7.",
        "out_row and out_col are 3-bit local coordinates. Tile extents r=min(8,M-8*tm), c=min(8,N-8*tn) are 4-bit unsigned values. Emit only out_row<r and out_col<c.",
        "Address arithmetic, runtime transfer-count products, tile-base arithmetic, and boundary comparisons use unsigned intermediates of at least 32 bits before conversion to parameter-derived address widths. This is sufficient for every legal parameter value.",

      "error_behavior": "Only illegal accepted command dimensions are reported: any zero or any value exceeding its bound causes error=1 for the following cycle, no job start, no memory write, and no done. There are no data last markers or timeouts; missing transfers wait indefinitely and extra transfers cannot be distinguished from subsequent host traffic. Violating producer payload stability is outside the legal protocol and has no guaranteed diagnostic.",
      "error_recovery": "An illegal command leaves the accelerator idle and ready for a corrected command immediately in the following cycle.     "latency_model": "Let L=M*K+K*N+N accepted input-data transfers and T=ceil(M/8)*ceil(N/8). One command transfer precedes L scalar load cycles. With uninterrupted input valid and output ready, final output acceptance occurs L+T*(1+17*K)+3*M*N rising-edge intervals after command acceptance. Add one interval for every load cycle without input acceptance and every EMIT cycle without output acceptance. There is no loading/compute/egress overlap. done becomes high immediately after final output acceptance and stays high for one clock cycle. A subsequent command can be accepted at the next rising edge. The 64-MAC step rate is one per 17 cycles during reduction, not one per cycle; full-job throughput also includes loading, clearing, and egress.",
    "architectural_invariants": [

      "Exactly one complete accumulator tile and one pending output element are live. The next tile cannot start until every valid output in the current tile is accepted.",
      "Output traversal is tile-row, tile-column, local-row, local-column order, with local column varying fastest; no global row-major ordering or reorder buffer is implied.",
      "All interface transfers and memory writes are suppressed by reset. No transfer occurs merely because valid is asserted.",

  "interface_contract": {
    "protocol": "Independent command, scalar input-data, and scalar output-data ready/valid channels; single active job. Unqueued done/error status pulses and busy status. All transfers occur on rising clk edges outside reset.",

Total is M*K+K*N+N transfers.",
        "ordering": "A then W then B, using runtime row strides K and N rather than maximum-parameter strides. Inputs are transmitted once per job. Partial compute tiles require no padded input transfers.",
